def update_row(session, kind, **update):

def write(p, obj=None, text=None):
    p = Path(p)
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if obj is not None:
        p.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2) + '\n')
    else:
        p.write_text(text)
